map_pois.name: Chapel Steps
map_pois.blurb: Up into Hollowmere, under the chapel's broken floor.

map_pois.name: Flooded Nave
map_pois.blurb: The nave, knee-deep. A waypoint stone glows under the water.

map_pois.name: Oracle's Pool
map_pois.blurb: A still pool where a Concord oracle drowned watching the sky.

map_pois.name: Reliquary
map_pois.blurb: Old offerings, some of them very old.

map_pois.name: The Scorched Altar
map_pois.blurb: The altar is burnt in rings, as if by a fire that came from inside time.
